steps.what: Verify research outcomes and define the report's findings and recommendation basis
Prepare report tables from the selected research outcomes
Prepare narrative reports or recommendations from the scientist's verified findings

loop.purpose: Word the scientist's findings and proposed recommendation
loop.input: Verified report brief and source-linked tables
loop.output: Draft report with evidence links and explicit uncertainties
loop.check: Scientist checks whether the recommendation follows from results and whether wording preserves limitations and alternative explanations
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported conclusions return to manual completion
loop.why_not_simpler: Recommendation wording varies with the research question; fixed templates cover table assembly

steps.what: Review and accept the report or recommendation for its intended recipient

tasks.design: Configure result tables from verified outcomes in {SPREADSHEET}, testing native reporting in {OTHER}, the laboratory notebook system, first. A bounded report draft in {DOCS} follows the scientist's interpretation, with human acceptance before handover.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research findings needed repeated table assembly and narrative wording for internal reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed mappings and source-bounded drafting can reuse established findings.
tasks.still_hard: A recommendation may overreach even when every quoted result is correct.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what action the evidence supports and make uncertainty explicit.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly; interpretation and recommendation responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How evidence strength limits a proposed next action

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts study reports and structures source documents; this supports scientific report assistance, not autonomous recommendation validity.
The local report workflow and savings scenario are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is internal outcome reporting, excluding original experiments, analysis and scientific article publication in 12932. Any reused table or text must be assigned once, not saved in both tasks.

Researchers produce outcome records before s1. The focal scientist captures result IDs/versions, values, units, sample groups, method context, qualifications, selected comparisons and recommendation rationale in s1; its 35 hours include all source verification and manual capture. Missing data require manual reporting; no free significant-finding or recommendation-approved flag is assumed.
Native laboratory report configuration precedes custom code. Existing automatically assembled tables earn no new labour saving.
unknowns: Actual table assembly and narrative effort
research_questions: Can the report preserve uncertainty and trace every table row to the exact research outcome version?

incremental.description: Report mappings and draft exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact outcome versions, tables, narrative, recommendation, qualifications and recipient scope accepted; any edit voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=35+18.75+20=73.75, gross=26.25, upkeep=7, net=19.25. Range 0-8 allows established templates, largely novel interpretation or extensive source repair.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study molecules using x-rays or electron microscopes and capture experimental observations
Interpret the evidence for spatial configurations of submicroscopic molecules

tasks.design: Retain physical investigation in {OTHER}, the diffraction or microscopy instrument system, and scientific interpretation with the researcher. {DOCS} preserves the evidence; no specific repeated reconstruction operation is established for a new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sample condition, measurement quality and structural ambiguity require scientific investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instrument processing can help but does not create a new labour saving by itself.
tasks.still_hard: Different structural models may fit limited or noisy observations.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the evidence supports the proposed molecular configuration.
tasks.altitude: Experimental and interpretive responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How measurement limits affect model identifiability

evidence.claim: Molecular structure investigation requires experimental and interpretive judgement; no specific new reconstruction automation or physical labour saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is molecular structural study, excluding later report production. Existing instrument processing is runtime rather than newly removed human effort.

The researcher verifies sample identity, preparation, instrument conditions and observation quality during s1 before interpretation in s2. Capture stays within the retained 70 hours. No free structurally-valid or suitable-sample flag is assumed.
OTHER means diffraction or microscopy instrument system. Test native analysis capabilities before custom code if a repeated operation is specified. No new service means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Actual structural methods and current reconstruction tools
research_questions: Which repeated reconstruction action remains manual after existing instrument processing?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Physical investigation and structural judgement retain their shares.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study the chemistry of living processes through targeted experiments and observation
Interpret evidence about cell development, respiration, digestion, growth, aging or death

tasks.design: Retain biological investigation and mechanistic interpretation with the scientist. {DOCS} preserves findings; no generic data pipeline is assumed for all living-process research.
tasks.previous_blocker: Methods and interpretation depend on the process, organism and experimental conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific repeatable analysis operation is established by this broad research statement.
tasks.still_hard: A measured association may reflect experimental conditions rather than the proposed biological mechanism.
tasks.human_edge: Design informative comparisons and judge competing explanations.
tasks.altitude: Research actions and scientific authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How experimental controls distinguish competing explanations

evidence.claim: Broad investigation of living processes does not establish a repeated calculation baseline; mechanistic research judgement remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is chemistry investigation and interpretation, excluding report production and separately assigned experiments. Overlap with physical-principles study must be assigned once in a roll-up.

The researcher defines the question and method before execution and captures material identity, conditions and observations within s1. Interpretation in s2 follows those observations. No structured confirmed-mechanism or valid-experiment flag is supplied free of work.
Native scientific tools precede custom code if a repeated analysis is later specified. No new service or work transfer is proposed; upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Methods, controls and current analysis routines
research_questions: Can a specific repeated operation be isolated without changing experimental or interpretive judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Neither research execution nor mechanistic judgement has an established reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the mutations study and verify sequence data and analysis parameters
Prepare repeatable variant analysis outputs for the mutations study
Interpret mutation evidence and assess its relation to cancer or other diseases

tasks.design: For the computational branch, configure a versioned variant-analysis workflow in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a scientist-verified manifest. Keep study design, data qualification and disease interpretation human; no clinical diagnosis or mutation-causality decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Re-running explicit analysis operations required repeated command and file assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned, tested pipeline components can rerun the defined processing steps.
tasks.still_hard: Detected variation does not establish disease causality, and pipeline quality depends on sample and reference choices.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether a variant observation supports the biological hypothesis and what validation is needed.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat analysis orchestration if currently manual; scientific interpretation and clinical boundaries remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How reference, parameters and quality controls affect variant evidence

evidence.claim: nf-core provides versioned, containerized bioinformatics pipelines with tests; this supports reproducible processing components rather than automated disease causality assessment.
The computational task boundary, local integration and time savings are conditional E1 scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is the existing computational sequence-analysis branch, excluding sample collection, sequencing, functional wet-lab validation and clinical reporting. A predominantly experimental study earns no physical work saving from this design.

Sequencing staff produce raw data and provenance before s1. The scientist verifies and captures sample/file IDs and checksums, consent/access scope, reference build, pipeline release, parameters, quality thresholds and intended comparisons within s1's 40 hours. Missing metadata or incompatible data stop for manual review; no free analysis-ready or pathogenic-variant flag is assumed.
Test native installed pipeline configuration before custom orchestration. Existing automatic runs earn no new labour saving; version validation and failures are counted below.
unknowns: Actual computational versus experimental task mix
Existing pipeline automation and permitted genetic-data access
research_questions: Can a validated run reproduce expected controls across the next data batch without manual command assembly?

already_counted.description: Study definition and analysis manifest capture

incremental.description: Pipeline release validation and failed-run investigation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=75, gross=25, upkeep=10, net=15. Range 0-5 allows existing workflow automation, substantial parameter validation or mostly experimental mutation research.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Report assembly and any residual computational run orchestration may shrink; biological investigation and causal interpretation remain human.
reach: Validate pipeline reproducibility with a bioinformatics scientist
Discuss mechanistic controls with a molecular and cellular biologist
skills_to_grow: Separation of variation from disease causality
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who can reproduce computational evidence and communicate it without confusing processed results with biological explanation.
